name: WTT- Armory
teaser: The official weapons pack forged by the WTT developers & friends...  Arm yourself accordingly...
description:
WTT Armory

The WTT Armory series returns to SPT 4.0

The largest WTT standalone release from the WTT Team & Allies featuring:

  • 50+ weapons

  • A countless amount of attachments

  • Custom quests

  • Unique “Boss” weapon variants pushed to boss loadouts

  • Loose loot spawns hand placed around the world

  • 1,000+ combined man hours spread among 11 WTT developers and many WTT friends.

A Fresh Coat of Paint

Many of the familiar weapons you’ve seen from the armory series in the past have received a fresh coat of paint. In many cases, these weapons have been completely remastered with new models, textures, sounds, and even new attachments. Over time, our skills and knowledge have improved, and we’ve made sure to incorporate that into our weapons.

In addition to remastering old weapons, we’ve also added several new weapons and attachments to the official Armory roster.

World Immersion - Traders / Loot Spawns / Boss Loadouts

While WTT Armory weapons have always been available through traders, we’ve gone the extra lengths to develop a system to allow these weapons to spawn in the world in hand placed locations on each map. Can you find all of the locations? Let the scavenger hunt begin…

In addition to loose loot spawns, we’ve also created and pushed unique variants of weapons to boss loadouts. Now you’ll have a chance of encountering one of these rare unique weapons from defeating a boss.

Disclaimers & Other Information

The original Little Drummer Boy magazines have been incorporated into WTT Armory and can be found on the ragfair for a price…

New custom optics have been incorporated into WTT Armory and can be found on the ragfair.

The SPT 3.11 version of this mod requires Virtuals Custom Quest Loader for the custom quests to work properly!

Help support our team!

Any funds donated will be put towards purchasing more assets for WTT!

Meet the Heavy Hitters

The Heavy Hitters of WTT- Armory

GrooveyPenguinX - Founder and Lead Developer of Welcome To Tarkov

An actual human wizard. The man behind the curtain who is creating our tools, creating and maintaining the codebase, and saving the asset creation world of SPT with actual magic. He was the author of the WTT Bundle Master- the tool that allowed porters to port 3.10 asset mods to 3.11 and asset modders to continue modding custom assets into the game before the SDK was ready and working. He’s also the author of WTT - W.A.A.C , WTT-PackNStrap, WTT - Lost Heads of Yojenks, WTT - Rogue Justice, and the original Small Cases mod.

Rockahorse - Founder and Lead Designer of Welcome To Tarkov

The man behind the lore and overall story of WTT. With one of the biggest creative brains on the team, this man brings our custom bosses, traders, and quests to life while seamlessly integrating them all into a cohesive plot design. Rockahorse was the author of WTT - Corner Store and WTT - Up In Smoke.

Tron (Myself) - Founder and Lead Asset Developer for Welcome To Tarkov

I’ve just gotten really good at memorizing what buttons to push to make nice looking, shiny objects that go boom. The WTT Armory series began over a year ago with my individual weapon mods that would go up on “WTT-Thursdays”.

EpicRangeTime - Senior Asset Developer

A heavy hitter in the department of attachments, he’s known for Epic’s All In One and WTT-Taste The Rainbow, he has become our resident expert at making optics and tactical devices, along with superior knowledge in making transparent attachments. He’s an awesome asset scout and has become my right hand guy in finding the best available assets that we can get our hands on. He’s also become our main sound designer, making our weapons sound that much better in the world.

WTT’s RISING STARS

These guys have really stepped up to the plate for this project and so this area is devoted to them.

Dsnyder - WTT Balancer turned WTT Developer

Dsnyder joined the team originally to help balance weapon pricing for the main WTT project. Over time, he began to expand into many other roles, including asset creation, helping tackle creation of meaningful trader assorts for the actual WTT overhaul, and much more. For Armory, he stepped up to the plate, hammering out all of the trader assorts for our weapons and also had a major role in placing loose loot weapon spawns in the world. Dsnyder continues to expand his skillset and has become one of my partners in asset creation. I look forward to getting him more involved in the asset creation process as time goes on. He is the author of the Unknown Survivor - Trader Mod .

Pidgeon - WTT Intern turned WTT Developer

Originally a WTT intern who has become a full on WTT developer. One of the few individuals to create a weapon container by himself, without DMing me a single time ( and lived to tell the tale…barely). With skills in hard surface modeling, he can create things out of thin air. Pidgeon was all over the board helping in different areas of Armory, from managing bug requests, to stat balancing, to planning for the project as a whole. We look forward to to working with Pidgeon as he develops his skills in asset creation.

Pois1x - WTT Community Volunteer Balancer turned WTT Developer

Originally a WTT Armory volunteer balancer who we chose from our community to help us balance our weapons. He has now become a full on WTT member. Pois1x was responsible for finding a discrepancy in the way our ironsights were being created. Fixing this issue led to most of our guns feeling a lot more natural to use. In addition, he’s responsible for balancing a majority of the weapons in WTT Armory. We look forward to having his assistance and balancing brain for the main project.

ProbablyEukyre (Victim Of SPT Staff) - WTT Intern turned WTT Developer and WTT Staff

Originally a WTT Intern who has become a full on WTT developer. Eukyre aka “Towel” , was my right hand man for tackling bugs during the Official WTT Armory beta test. His fastest bug fix came in at a hot 24 seconds flat from diagnosing the issue to sending the fix to our Armory github repo.

He’s also the author of ECOT - Eukyre’s Consortium of Things. He continues to learn and perfect his skills in asset creation, and is looking forward to helping develop WTT as time goes on.

Special Thanks

The following individuals played an important role in WTT Armory through asset creation, media creation, or Beta Testing. This area is devoted to them.

Choccy - The modder responsible for our M249 custom animations. We are proud to have had the opportunity to collaborate with this animation wizard.

Fontaine - The SPT Realism man himself serves as an internal advisor to WTT. He also created the BepInEx plugin that allows the AN94 to have proper hyperburst!

Acer - Our media expert who diligently provided us with beautiful artwork for our official hub submission. A lot of the art work you see here was created by him!

Check out his awesome community where he showcases some of his crazy talent in creating weapon and vehicle rigs.

Kobalt - A volunteer community balancer who helped balance some of the weapons in WTT Armory. Thank you Kobalt!

What is WTT?

What is Welcome To Tarkov?

Welcome To Tarkov (WTT) is a mod for SPT AKI that has been in development for over a year. What started as a small passion project has grown in size to incorporate 15+ core members as well as contributions from other well-known mod authors and friends of WTT alike.

How does Welcome To Tarkov change the game?

As a mod, WTT overhauls SPT AKI, touching on almost every vanilla game system, as well as adding completely new systems to the game and its core mechanics. Inspired by open-world hardcore survival projects like STALKER: Anomaly and STALKER: GAMMA, WTT takes SPT’s artificial multiplayer MMO difficulty adders and replaces them with a challenging world economy, loot scarcity rebalancing, a lore friendly quest overhaul, and a map-traveling system built from rewritten portions of the Traveler mod allowing seamless travel between maps. Aside from its changes to the game’s core properties, WTT also adds to the world’s variety of traders, NPC’s, characters, items, and quests:

  • Over 1,000 custom bundles adding new weapons, attachments, wearables, containers, food, medical, and barter items.
  • New bosses with their own custom gear that will be properly incorporated into WTT’s quest lines.
  • New, meaningful traders with their own lore-friendly quests and narrative elements to help the player progress through the story-line of WTT.
  • New playable characters and outfits that will add to the player’s customization abilities.
  • New quest types incorporating brand new map extraction points, putting the player’s knowledge and familiarization of SPT’s maps to the test.

Welcome To Tarkov stands as one of the largest mods created for SPT AKI thus far.
